title: Problem with building on Ubuntu 14.04 LTS 32-Bit
body:
Hi!

I would like to use netty for communication with a native application via Unix Domain Sockets and I tried to use transport-native-epoll module but only artifacts for 64-Bit systems are officially provided at the moment. 

So I tried to build netty-tcnative and transport-epoll-module on my own, but I got an error while building tcnative c sources:

> [INFO] src/ssl.c: In function 'Java_org_apache_tomcat_jni_SSL_newMemBIO':
> [INFO] src/ssl.c:1070:16: error: cast from pointer to integer of different size [-Werror=pointer-to-int-cast]
> [INFO]          return (jlong) NULL;
> [INFO]                 ^
> [INFO] cc1: all warnings being treated as errors
> [INFO] make: **\* [src/ssl.lo] Fehler 1
> [INFO] rc: 2

How to fix this error correctly? I added an additional cast to `intptr_t` before casting to `jlong`:

``` c
return (jlong)(intptr_t) NULL
```

After this change I was able to execute `mvn clean install` without any problems for _tcnative_ (but I'm not sure if this fix is correct because I'm not familiar with JNI). 

Then I tried to build transport-native-epoll. I got similar errors (in several files) to the one listed above. For example, the errors for io_netty_channel_unix_Socket.c are:

> [INFO] libtool: compile:  gcc -DHAVE_CONFIG_H -I. -I./src -O3 -Werror -I/opt/jdk1.8.0_65//include -I/opt/jdk1.8.0_65//include/linux -c src/io_netty_channel_unix_Socket.c  -fPIC -DPIC -o src/.libs/io_netty_channel_unix_Socket.o
> [INFO] src/io_netty_channel_unix_Socket.c: In function 'Java_io_netty_channel_unix_Socket_sendToAddress':
> [INFO] src/io_netty_channel_unix_Socket.c:541:29: error: cast to pointer from integer of different size [-Werror=int-to-pointer-cast]
> [INFO]      return _sendTo(env, fd, (void_) memoryAddress, pos, limit, address, scopeId, port);
> [INFO]                              ^
> [INFO] src/io_netty_channel_unix_Socket.c: In function 'Java_io_netty_channel_unix_Socket_sendToAddresses':
> [INFO] src/io_netty_channel_unix_Socket.c:554:17: error: cast to pointer from integer of different size [-Werror=int-to-pointer-cast]
> [INFO]      m.msg_iov = (struct iovec_) memoryAddress;
> [INFO]                  ^
> [INFO] src/io_netty_channel_unix_Socket.c: In function 'Java_io_netty_channel_unix_Socket_recvFromAddress':
> [INFO] src/io_netty_channel_unix_Socket.c:576:31: error: cast to pointer from integer of different size [-Werror=int-to-pointer-cast]
> [INFO]      return _recvFrom(env, fd, (void_) address, pos, limit);
> [INFO]                                ^
> [INFO] cc1: all warnings being treated as errors
> [INFO] make: *_\* [src/io_netty_channel_unix_Socket.lo] Fehler 1
> [INFO] rc: 2

I fixed these errors in the same way (as mentioned for tcnative) by adding an additional cast to `intptr_t`:

``` c
return _sendTo(env, fd, (void*)(intptr_t) memoryAddress, pos, limit, address, scopeId, port);
```

After fixing all errors in this way I was able to build transport-native-epoll, but the unit tests that relate to SSL failed. Perhaps because my fix (of ssl.c of tcnative) was not correct?

Is there a chance to get transport-native-epoll running on 32-Bit systems? If so, how do I have to fix the problems mentioned above correctly? 

Thank you very much!
